title: Brihaspati’s Curse and Tara’s Child
description: The story of how one of the key ancestors of the Pandavas and Kauravas was born—from Tara's love for the moon god Chandra to the birth and curse of Budha.

title: The Origin of the Chandravamshis
description: The complete story of King Sudhyumna's transformation, the birth of the lunar dynasty, Emperor Nahusha's fall, and Kacha's quest for the secret Sanjeevini mantra.

title: Curses or Blessings?
description: The story of a friendship turned bitter between Devyani and Princess Sharmishtha, King Yayati's secret affair, and the exchange of youth that shaped the Kuru dynasty.

title: Shakuntala and the Birth of Bharata
description: Following the lineage of Puru (ancestor of the Pandavas and Kauravas) and Yadu (ancestor of the Yadavas), this story tells of Vishwamitra and Menaka, the birth and forest upbringing of Shakuntala, her fateful encounter with King Dushyanta, the curse of Sage Durvasa, and the rise of Emperor Bharata.

title: Shantanu Meets Ganga
description: The story of Emperor Bharata's wisdom in choosing a successor based on merit, the celestial curse of Mahabhishek and Ganga, and their fateful meeting on the riverbank.

title: The Birth of Devavrata
description: The tragic fate of Shantanu and Ganga's first seven children, the cosmic backstory of Sage Vasishta's curse on the Vasus, and the rise of Devavrata.

title: Devavrata Becomes Bhishma
description: The origins of Satyavati, King Shantanu's overwhelming infatuation, and the fierce vow that transformed Devavrata into Bhishma.

title: Amba’s Plight
description: Shantanu's sons with Satyavati, the tragic fate of Prince Chitrangada, Bhishma's abduction of the Princesses of Kashi, and Amba's heartbreaking journey of rejection.

title: Amba Thirsts For Revenge
description: Amba's spiral from despair to revenge, her quest to find a warrior capable of defeating Bhishma, the bitter duel with Parashurama, Karthikeya's lotus garland, and Shiva's ultimate boon.

title: The Yadava Clan and Krishna’s Birth
description: The origins of Yadu's lineage in Mathura, Kamsa's tyrannical rise, the miraculous rescues of Balarama and Krishna, and the interconnecting bonds between the Yadava and Kuru dynasties.
